g1-implement.imperative: Fill templates/IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF.template.md for this gate: build scripts/race_week_stages.py with (a) checkpoint I/O helpers (read_checkpoint/write_checkpoint over outputs/race_week/<year>/<round>/{01_sessions,02_prediction,03_lineup}.json + 04_explainer.md/.STUB.md), (b) compute_stage_inputs_hash(upstream_checkpoint_dict) -> sha256 hex over canonical JSON, (c) should_skip_stage(existing_checkpoint, upstream_checkpoint) -> bool pure function, (d) four pure stage functions taking already-loaded dicts/params and returning the new checkpoint dict content: discover_sessions_stage (calls get_practice_session_types(year, gp_name) + DatabaseManager.has_session_classification per session -> status complete|partial|missing + landed list), predict_stage (constructs a SimpleNamespace matching src.evo_predictor.run.cmd_sampled_predict's arg contract -- year, race, db_path, compound_prior_root, sampled_runtime_manifest, output=None -- and calls cmd_sampled_predict directly in-process, returning its payload), optimize_stage (calls src.fantasy_scoring.artifacts.generate_report(sampled_runtime_path=<02 checkpoint path>, year=, round_num=, output_stem=<03 checkpoint stem>, ...) -- IMPORTANT, verified at artifacts.py:227: generate_report ALREADY calls write_beam_search_report INTERNALLY and writes both 03_lineup.json and 03_lineup.md itself; do NOT call write_beam_search_report a second time, that would double-write. The stage function's job after calling generate_report is: read back the returned report dict, select the top-10 lineup via --lane in {mean,risk,balanced} default balanced (report['beam_outputs']['best_mean'|'best_risk'|'best_balanced']['lineup']), and inject a top-level lane_used field into the already-written 03_lineup.json (re-read, patch, re-write, or pass the lane through generate_report's caller so the field is present in the single write -- implementer's call which approach is cleaner, but the FINAL on-disk 03_lineup.json must carry lane_used) -- NOTE: FantasyBeamSearchResult has NO best_max attribute, verified at src/fantasy_scoring/beam_search.py:52-63 and :396-421 -- lane choices are exactly {mean,risk,balanced}), explain_stage (copies the .md twin generate_report already produced at the 03 stem to 04_explainer.md; on any failure/missing input writes 04_explainer.STUB.md and returns success=True so this never blocks the hard gate). Write unit tests in tests/unit/scripts/test_race_week_stages.py exercising each stage as a pure function over fixture checkpoint dicts (mock DatabaseManager/cmd_sampled_predict/generate_report where the real call would touch DB/FastF1). No src/ changes -- fence is scripts/race_week_stages.py + tests/ only. Cite exact seam signatures from MISSION_FRAME.md's Governing Constraints section (db-path default footgun, compound-prior-root requirement, get_practice_session_types, has_session_classification, generate_report's internal write_beam_search_report call, beam_search_lineups result shape). Dispatch a subagent invoking constellation-implementer with the completed handoff. Wait for and integrate the returned IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.

g2-implement.title: G2 CLI dispatcher (scripts/race_week.py): implement
g2-implement.imperative: Fill templates/IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF.template.md: build scripts/race_week.py, a thin CLI over G1's scripts/race_week_stages.py. Subcommands: collect-check, predict, optimize, explain, and a run convenience command chaining all four. Global args: --year (int, required), --race (gp name, required), --output-root (default outputs/race_week), --force (bypass hash-skip). predict args: --manifest (default params/gold/sampled_runtime_manifest.json -- the GOLD manifest; overridable for testing), --compound-prior-root (default params/gold/compound_prior), --db-path (explicit override) / --db-root (directory containing f1_data_{year}.db, default 'data') -- resolution order: --db-path if given, else <db-root>/f1_data_{year}.db, else Config.db_path_for_year(year) as the safe default (NEVER fall through to the fixed Config.DATABASE_PATH). optimize args: --lane {mean,risk,balanced} default balanced (NOT 4 choices -- best_max does not exist on FantasyBeamSearchResult, see G1 handoff). Round-number resolution: get_calendar(year).index(gp_name) + 1 (src/data/collector.py:232 pattern). collect-check subcommand is report-only in v1 (diffs expected vs landed sessions, writes 01_sessions.json, prints a human-readable gap summary) -- it does NOT invoke the collector. run aborts loudly (nonzero exit, no 04 write attempt skipped) if predict or optimize fails BEFORE ever calling explain; explain always exits 0 (STUB on failure). Resumption: each subcommand loads its upstream checkpoint(s), computes should_skip_stage, and skips (prints 'skipped: unchanged') unless --force or inputs changed. Add a DB-path threading acceptance check as an automated test (assert resolved db_path == Config.db_path_for_year(year) when no override is passed, NOT the fixed data/f1_data.db). Add a hard/soft gate ordering test (failure-injection): mock predict_stage or optimize_stage to raise, and assert (a) run exits nonzero, (b) explain_stage / 04_explainer.* is never invoked/written -- the hard gate must never be silently bypassed by an eager explain call. Add an invalid --race handling test: an unknown GP name propagates a clear error from get_calendar(year).index(gp_name) (ValueError), not a swallowed/silent failure. Write CLI-level tests in tests/unit/scripts/test_race_week_cli.py (argument parsing, db-path resolution, lane validation, resumption skip/rerun decisions, the failure-injection test, the invalid-race test) using fixtures/mocks -- no real DB/FastF1/prediction calls in unit tests. No src/ changes. Dispatch constellation-implementer. Wait for and integrate IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.
